meta.title: Fire Simulation Training Systems
meta.description: TZJ fire simulation training systems use gas and electronic flame and smoke effects to recreate multiple fire scenarios—safe, clean, and repeatable for high-frequency instruction and routine drill programs.

hero.title: Fire Simulation Training Systems
hero.description: Safe, clean, and repeatable—bring high-frequency instruction and routine drills to any site with simulated flame and smoke.

jsonLd.productDescription: Gas and electronic simulation of flame and smoke for multiple fire scenarios—safe, clean, and repeatable.

overview.title: Not every drill needs live fire
overview.description: For equipment handling, initial attack, and workforce training, simulation delivers a strong balance of realism and control—safer, cleaner, and more cost-effective.
overview.lead: Fire intensity and smoke levels are adjustable, so one system covers multiple fire scenarios and training tiers.
overview.body: Complements CFBT live-fire facilities: simulation handles high-frequency instruction; live fire handles advanced tactical training—a stronger combined program.

features.title: Multi-scenario simulation
features.desc: Simulate pan fires, gas, electrical, kitchen, and other fire types from a single facility.

features.title: Adjustable conditions
features.desc: Scale flame and smoke intensity from introductory lessons through advanced practical drills.

features.title: High-frequency repeatability
features.desc: Fast ignition and reset support large-volume, routine, repeatable training.

features.title: Clean and eco-friendly
features.desc: Primarily gas and electronic simulation with minimal smoke—ideal for indoor and densely populated areas.

features.title: Lower operating cost
features.desc: No solid fuel or frequent liner replacement—more economical over the long term.

features.title: Safe and controllable
features.desc: Safety interlocks and emergency shutoff keep the training environment safe, controlled, and auditable.

programs: Extinguisher and hose line equipment operation

Kitchen, electrical, and gas fire simulation drills
Workforce and public fire safety training
Routine drill programs for career departments
